test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What happens when we exhale during normal breathing?

options.text: A residual amount of air remains in the lungs
All carbon dioxide is expelled from the body

solution:
The correct answer is **__A residual amount of air remains in the lungs__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The process of exhaling carbon dioxide from the body is known as **expiration.**
 
• Expiration happens when the **air pressure outside increases**.
 
• During expiration, the **external intercostal muscles relax** and the **internal intercostal muscles contract**. 
 
• The size of the thoracic cavity decreases, this **relaxes the ****diaphragm,** and the **lungs get compressed**.
 
• Also, a residual amount of air remains in the lungs which is known as **residual volume.**
